name: Hugging Face Hub API
summary: Search and inspect machine-learning models, datasets and Spaces on the Hugging Face Hub, plus daily papers; public reads need no token.
description: The Hub API lists and filters public models, datasets and Spaces with metadata such as downloads, likes, tags, library, pipeline task, license tag, last-modified date and file listings, and exposes daily papers. It is documented by an OpenAPI 3.1 spec. Private repos and writes need a free access token.

auth.notes: Public read endpoints answered without a token; a free access token (Authorization: Bearer hf_...) is needed for private or gated repos and for writes.

rate_limit.summary: Anonymous API-bucket budget seen in response headers: 500 requests per 5-minute fixed window (RateLimit-Policy q=500, w=300); the docs describe separate buckets for other request classes.

endpoints.summary: Full metadata for one model repo
Papers featured on the daily papers page

license.name: Varies per repository; metadata API governed by Hugging Face Terms of Service

agent_notes: Page by following the Link: rel="next" header (cursor based), not an offset. Add full=true for siblings, card data and config; default list rows are slim. Repo ids are owner/name. The license of a model is in its tags as license:<id>.
caveats: The 500-per-5-minutes budget was read from RateLimit headers for anonymous callers; the docs say limits differ for authenticated and other request classes.
Papers with Code (paperswithcode.com/api) now redirects to huggingface.co/papers/trending, so its API is gone.
A limit above 1000 is silently capped at 1000 rows.
CORS echoes the request Origin on the endpoints tested.
